messages.content:
Risk: Fraud, scams
Description: The AI system may be exploited to facilitate fraudulent activities, scams, or targeted manipulation, including generating deepfakes and enhancing phishing attacks.
Concern: None
Policy: Fraud

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0015: Evade AI Model - ATLAS — Adversaries can [Craft Adversarial Data](/techniques/AML.T0043) that prevents an AI model from correctly identifying the contents of the data or [Generate Deepfakes](/techniques/AML.T0088) that fools an AI model expecting authentic data.

This technique can be used to evade a downstream task where AI is utilized. The adversary may evade AI-based virus/malware detection or network scanning towards the goal of a traditional cyber attack. AI model evasion through deepfake generation may also provide initial access to systems that use AI-based biometric authentication. [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: Denial of AI Service - ATLAS, Spamming AI System with Chaff Data - ATLAS, Erode Dataset Integrity - ATLAS
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#T1588.007: Artificial Intelligence — Adversaries may obtain access to generative artificial intelligence tools, such as large language models (LLMs), to aid various techniques during targeting. These tools may be used to inform, bolster, and enable a variety of malicious tasks including conducting [Reconnaissance](https://attack.mitre.org/tactics/TA0043), creating basic scripts, assisting social engineering, and even developing payloads.(Citation: MSFT-AI) [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: Vulnerabilities, Exploits, Digital Certificates
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HarmfulHowTo: Harmful How-To — Step-by-step instructions for activities that cause property destruction, physical harm, or enable illegal intrusion when executed by unauthorized individuals. [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: CBRN Information, Drug Synthesis, Dual-Use Research Concern
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#ContentFiltering: Content Filtering — Content Filtering techniques aid in the process of analyzing an input file for malicious or erroneous content and outputing a sanitized version. [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: Message Analysis, Restore Object, Restore Access
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0048.002: Societal Harm - ATLAS — Societal harms might generate harmful outcomes that reach either the general public or specific vulnerable groups such as the exposure of children to vulgar content. [found by 2/10 queries]
  Siblings: User Harm - ATLAS, Reputational Harm - ATLAS, Financial Harm - ATLAS

axes.rationale: Adversaries can use AI evasion techniques like deepfakes to facilitate fraud and scams by bypassing AI-based security measures.
AI systems themselves can be used as tools for fraud, such as in generating deepfakes or enhancing phishing attacks.
